description: Reverse a custom network protocol from captured traffic or the client binary: recover the frame layout, message-type dictionary, field meanings, and state machine. Load for custom TCP/UDP binary protocols, Protobuf/gRPC without reflection, FlatBuffers/MessagePack, WebSocket/MQTT/private RPC framing, PCAP-driven format recovery, length-prefixed or TLV frames, magic bytes, CRC/checksum fields, or encrypted frame headers.
